study type: Methodological study with an application to birth register data
cohort: The study's application involved babies from birth register data.
finding: The preferential within-cluster matching approach was found to be effective in reducing bias due to cluster-level confounders and minimizing unmatched units across different cluster sizes.
mod_finding: The methodological approaches were applied to estimate the effect of caesarean section on the Apgar score using birth register data.
